description: Score a public URL for AI crawlers, llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD, metadata, headings, and answer-first content.

name: OG image generator

description: Design an Open Graph image in the browser. Choose from 18 templates, set the fields that template uses, download a PNG, or copy a Next.js opengraph-image.tsx file.

name: JWT decoder
tagline: Paste a JSON Web Token, read the claims, and verify the signature in the browser.
description: Decode a JWT and verify HS, RS, PS, ES, and EdDSA signatures in the browser. The token and keys are not uploaded.

name: robots.txt checker
tagline: Read allow and disallow rules, sitemap links, and the mistakes that make a robots.txt file lie.
description: Fetch a public robots.txt, list Allow and Disallow rules and sitemap links, and flag common mistakes. Private addresses are blocked.

name: Meta tags inspector
tagline: Read title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter, and JSON-LD types from one public URL.
description: Inspect a public page for title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, Twitter cards, and JSON-LD types. A checklist marks what social previews and AI search need.

name: JSON-LD schema generator
tagline: Fill a form, get valid schema.org JSON-LD for Article, FAQ, Product, Organization, and more.
description: Free JSON-LD schema markup generator. Build Article, BlogPosting, FAQPage, HowTo, Product, Organization, Person, LocalBusiness, BreadcrumbList, SoftwareApplication, WebSite, and Event schema, then copy the script tag or a Next.js component.

name: AI token counter
tagline: Count tokens and estimate the API cost of a prompt for GPT, Claude, and Gemini models.
description: Free LLM token counter and API cost calculator. Paste text to count tokens with OpenAI's tokenizers and estimate input and output cost across GPT, Claude, Gemini, and other models.

name: Cron expression builder
tagline: Build or paste a cron schedule, read it in plain English, and see the next run times.
description: Free cron expression generator and explainer. Build a schedule visually or paste one to translate it into plain English, validate it, and preview the next 10 run times in any timezone. Supports standard 5-field cron, seconds, Quartz, and macros.

name: Next.js Dockerfile generator
tagline: Generate a production multi-stage Dockerfile for Next.js, plus .dockerignore and compose.
description: Free Next.js Dockerfile generator. Pick your package manager, Node version, standalone output, Prisma, and healthcheck, and get a small multi-stage Dockerfile with .dockerignore, docker-compose.yml, and next.config settings.

name: JSON formatter
tagline: Pretty-print, minify, and validate JSON, with the exact line and column when it fails.
description: Free JSON formatter and JSON validator that runs in the browser. Choose an indent of 2, 4, or a tab, sort object keys, minify, and read a tree of the value. Invalid JSON reports the line, the column, and the line of source.

name: JSON YAML converter
tagline: Convert JSON, YAML, TOML, and XML in the browser, and keep the line number when a document fails.
description: Free converter for JSON to YAML, YAML to JSON, TOML, and XML to JSON. The source format can be detected automatically. Errors include a line and column. Conversion stays in the browser.

name: CSV JSON converter
tagline: Convert CSV to JSON and JSON back to CSV, with a delimiter and a header row you choose.
description: Free CSV to JSON and JSON to CSV converter. Pick a comma, tab, semicolon, or pipe, or let the first row decide. Keep or drop the header, infer booleans and numbers, and flatten nested JSON into dotted columns. It runs in the browser.

name: Diff checker
tagline: Compare two texts side by side or inline, and download a unified patch.
description: Free diff checker for text and JSON. Compare by line, word, or character, ignore whitespace, or diff JSON so key order does not matter. The result is a side-by-side view, an inline view, and a unified patch. It runs in the browser.

name: Base64 codec
tagline: Encode and decode Base64 for text or a file, including the URL-safe alphabet.
description: Free Base64 encode and Base64 decode tool for text and files. Turn on URL-safe output, wrap a file as a data URI, or decode a data URI back to text or a download. The file never leaves the browser.

name: Image format converter
tagline: Convert HEIC, WebP, PNG, JPG, and AVIF in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
description: Free image format converter for HEIC to JPG, WebP to PNG, PNG to JPG, and AVIF. Drop a batch, pick a target, and download the files or a ZIP. Decoding and encoding run on this device, so the pictures never leave the browser.

name: Image compressor
tagline: Shrink JPEG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF in the browser, with the real before and after size.
description: Free image compressor. Set a quality level, optionally cap the long edge, and compress a batch of JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF files. You see the size before and after, the savings, and you can download a ZIP. The work stays on this device.

name: Image resizer
tagline: Resize by pixels or percent, with the aspect ratio locked and a batch ZIP.
description: Free image resizer. Set a width, a height, or a percent, lock the aspect ratio, and fit a batch with contain, cover, or stretch. Presets cover Instagram, Stories, Open Graph, and HD. Resizing runs in the browser, so the files stay on the device.

name: Color converter
tagline: Turn any color into HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, and CMYK, and check the contrast ratio.
description: Free color converter and contrast checker. Paste HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, CMYK, or a CSS color name and read every format back. The contrast ratio uses WCAG 2, with AA and AAA flags for normal and large text, plus the nearest Tailwind token.

name: Unix timestamp converter
tagline: Turn epoch seconds or milliseconds into a date, and a date in any time zone back into epoch time.
description: Free epoch converter for unix timestamps. Switch between seconds, milliseconds, microseconds, and nanoseconds, read ISO-8601 and RFC 2822 dates, and convert both ways across IANA time zones. Runs in the browser.

name: Date difference calculator
tagline: Count the days, weeks, and business days between two dates.
description: Free date calculator for the exact days between two dates. See the calendar span, elapsed time, weeks, and business days with weekends and your own holiday list excluded. Runs in the browser.

name: Hash generator
tagline: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512 checksums for text or a file, with HMAC.
description: Free SHA-256 and MD5 hash generator. Checksum text or a file with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, and SHA-512, copy hex or base64, compare an expected digest, and compute HMAC. The bytes stay in the browser.

name: UUID generator
tagline: Generate UUID v4 or v7 in bulk, and read the time stored in a v7 id.
description: Free UUID and GUID generator for version 4 and version 7. Create one id or a bulk list from cryptographic randomness, then inspect a UUID to see its version, variant, and v7 timestamp.

name: URL encoder and parser
tagline: Encode or decode a URL, then break the query string into parameters.
description: Free URL encoder and decoder. Percent-encode a component or a whole URL, decode it again, and parse a URL into its host, path, and query parameters. Edit the query and copy the rebuilt URL. Runs in the browser.

name: Password generator
tagline: Cryptographic passwords and passphrases, with an entropy strength meter.
description: Free strong password generator. Build a password with crypto.getRandomValues, choose the length and character sets, skip ambiguous characters, or make a passphrase. The strength meter shows the entropy in bits.

name: Chmod calculator
tagline: Turn a permission grid into octal and symbolic chmod, and back.
description: Free chmod calculator. Check read, write, and execute for owner, group, and others, including setuid, setgid, and the sticky bit. See the octal mode, the symbolic mode, and the chmod command.

name: Merge PDF
tagline: Combine PDFs in the browser. Reorder them, keep a page range from each file, and download one document.
description: Free PDF merger. Combine PDFs in the browser, drag them into order, and keep a page range such as 1-3,5 from each file. The merge runs on this device. The files are not uploaded.

name: Split PDF
tagline: Extract a page range, or split a PDF into single pages or chunks, then download a PDF or a ZIP.
description: Free split PDF tool. Extract pages with a range such as 1-3,5, save every page as its own PDF, or split every N pages. The work runs in the browser and the file is not uploaded. Several files download as a ZIP.

name: Compress PDF
tagline: Shrink a PDF in the browser. Pick a preset or a target size and compare the file before and after.
description: Free PDF compressor. Shrink a PDF for an upload limit without sending it anywhere. Light, medium, and strong presets recompress embedded images and clear document info. Text stays selectable. A target of 100 KB, 200 KB, or 500 KB tries harder until the file fits or the smallest result is reached.

name: Image to PDF
tagline: Turn JPG, PNG, and WebP images into one PDF. Set the page size, orientation, margin, and order.
description: Free JPG to PDF and image to PDF converter. Drop JPG, PNG, or WebP pictures, put them in order, and choose A4, Letter, or a page that fits the picture. Portrait, landscape, or automatic orientation, with a margin. The PDF is built in the browser and the images are not uploaded.

name: QR code generator
tagline: Make a static QR code for text, a URL, Wi-Fi, or a vCard. Set the colors and error correction, then download SVG or PNG.
description: Free QR code generator for a URL, plain text, a Wi-Fi network, or a vCard. Pick the colors and the error-correction level, then download SVG and PNG. The code is static: it does not track scans, and it is drawn in this browser.

name: PDF to Text
tagline: Read the selectable text of a PDF, with a markdown heading when the type is larger.
description: Free PDF to text tool. Pull the text layer from each page, keep a rough markdown heading, and count tokens. Scanned pages without a text layer are left blank. This tool does not OCR. The file stays in the browser.

name: Rotate PDF
tagline: Reorder, rotate, or drop pages, then download the PDF.
description: Free rotate and organize PDF tool. Drag pages into a new order, turn a page by 90 degrees, or delete a page. Thumbnails are drawn in the browser. The file is not uploaded.

name: PDF to Image
tagline: Render PDF pages to PNG or JPEG, then download one image or a ZIP.
description: Free PDF to image tool. Pick PNG or JPEG, a DPI from 72 to 216, and a page range. One page downloads as an image. Several pages download as a ZIP. The render runs in this browser.

name: Protect PDF
tagline: Add an AES password, or unlock a PDF when you already know the password.
description: Free protect and unlock PDF tool. Set a user password and optional owner password, and choose print, copy, and edit permissions. Unlock writes a copy that opens without the password. The password has to be one you know. The file stays in this browser.

name: Markdown HTML
tagline: Convert Markdown to HTML, or HTML back to Markdown, with a live preview.
description: Free Markdown and HTML converter. GitHub-flavored Markdown in, HTML out, or the other way with Turndown. A sanitize switch strips scripts from the text output. The preview is always sanitized. Nothing is uploaded.

name: Page to Markdown
tagline: Fetch a public page and turn the article into Markdown.
description: Free HTML to Markdown tool for a public URL. The page is fetched on the server, private addresses are refused, and Readability keeps the article. Navigation and scripts are stripped. The result includes a token count.

name: QR and barcode reader
tagline: Read QR codes and barcodes from a photo, a paste, or the camera.
description: Free QR and barcode reader. Drop an image, paste one, or scan with the camera. Several codes in one picture are listed with their format. Decoding runs in this browser, so the photo stays on the device.

name: SVG optimizer
tagline: Minify an SVG, compare the size, and keep the viewBox unless you turn that off.
description: Free SVG optimizer. SVGO runs in this browser: comments, metadata, and extra precision come out, and you can turn each pass off. The viewBox stays unless you remove it. The file is not uploaded.

name: EXIF viewer and remover
tagline: Read photo metadata, including GPS, and strip all of it or only the location.
description: Free EXIF viewer and metadata remover. See the camera, the time, and the GPS coordinates, then download a copy with every tag removed or with only the GPS block taken out of a JPEG. Reading and stripping run in this browser.

name: Image cropper
tagline: Crop with a free box or an aspect preset, including a circle.
description: Free image cropper. Drag the frame, lock an aspect such as 1:1, 4:5, 16:9, or Open Graph, and export JPG, PNG, or WebP. A circle crop keeps a round mask. Cropping runs in this browser.

name: Favicon generator
tagline: Make the ICO, the PNG sizes, the manifest, and the HTML snippet from a picture or letters.
description: Free favicon generator. Start from an image or up to three letters, then download a ZIP with favicon.ico, the PNG sizes, a web manifest, an HTML snippet, and a Next.js metadata snippet. The pack is built in this browser.

name: Image to text
tagline: Read the words in a picture. The OCR model downloads once and runs in this browser.
description: Free image to text. Tesseract reads the picture in this browser after a one-time download of the language data. Pick a language, then copy or download the text. A progress line shows the download and the recognition.

name: Background remover
tagline: Cut out a portrait in the browser, or clear a solid backdrop without a download.
description: Free background remover. A portrait uses MODNet, an Apache-2.0 matting model that downloads once and runs in this browser, with a progress line while it loads. A solid backdrop can be cleared instantly by sampling the corners. RMBG-1.4 is not used because its license is non-commercial. The picture is not uploaded.

name: Word counter
tagline: Words, graphemes, reading time, and the limits a title or post has to fit.
description: Free word counter and character counter. Counts words with Intl.Segmenter, code points, graphemes, sentences, and paragraphs, then checks SEO title, meta description, X, SMS, Bluesky, and Instagram limits.

name: Case converter
tagline: camelCase, snake_case, and title case, including AP and Chicago rules.
description: Free text case converter. See lower, upper, sentence, capital, AP title case, Chicago title case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, CONSTANT_CASE, kebab-case, and the rest at once.

name: Lorem ipsum
tagline: Placeholder copy, or fake rows as JSON, CSV, and SQL, from a seed.
description: Free lorem ipsum and fake data generator. Write words, sentences, or paragraphs, or build a small table of names, emails, and other fields and download JSON, CSV, or SQL. The same seed repeats the same rows.

name: Regex tester
tagline: Test a JavaScript pattern, read the groups, and preview a replacement.
description: Free JavaScript regex tester. Set flags, see every match and capture group, read a short explanation of the pattern, and preview a replacement. The match list is exact, which is what an agent needs when a model guesses.

name: SQL formatter
tagline: Format SQL for PostgreSQL, MySQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, and other dialects.
description: Free SQL formatter. Pick a dialect, choose upper, lower, or preserved keywords, and indent with 2 or 4 spaces. Formatting runs in the browser.

name: JSON Schema
tagline: Infer a schema from JSON, validate against one, and export TypeScript and Zod.
description: Free JSON Schema generator and validator. Infer a schema from a sample, check a document against a schema you paste, and export TypeScript types and a Zod object. Errors include the path that failed.

name: Loan EMI calculator
tagline: A monthly installment and the full amortization table, rounded to the cent.
description: Free loan, EMI, and mortgage calculator. Enter principal, annual rate, and term. See the installment, total interest, and every payment. Extra monthly payments shorten the schedule. Amounts use decimal rounding, not binary floats.

name: Percentage calculator
tagline: Percent of, percent change, reverse percent, and margin, with the formula shown.
description: Free percentage calculator. Find X% of Y, what percent X is of Y, the change from one number to another, the original value, an increase or decrease, and margin versus markup. Arithmetic uses decimal rounding.

name: Unit converter
tagline: Length, mass, temperature, and data sizes, with decimal and binary units kept apart.
description: Free unit converter for length, mass, volume, temperature, area, speed, and time, plus decimal data units (kB, MB) and binary data units (KiB, MiB). Set the number of decimal places.

name: DNS lookup
tagline: Query A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, and CAA over DNS-over-HTTPS.
description: Free DNS lookup. Ask Cloudflare or Google for A, AAAA, MX, TXT, CNAME, and CAA records, and read SPF and DMARC from the TXT answers. Queries run on the server. Private names are refused.

name: CIDR calculator
tagline: Network, broadcast, host range, and membership for IPv4 and IPv6.
description: Free subnet calculator. Enter an IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR and see the network, mask, broadcast, first and last host, and the address count. Test whether an address is inside, split the block, or merge adjacent networks.

name: Bcrypt hash
tagline: Hash and verify passwords with bcrypt or argon2id. Nothing is stored.
description: Free bcrypt and argon2id generator. Hash a password in the browser, copy an htpasswd line, or verify an existing hash. The password is not sent, logged, or stored.

name: Key pair
tagline: Generate RSA, EC, and Ed25519 keys, and convert PEM and JWK.
description: Free key pair generator. Create an RSA, ECDSA, or Ed25519 key in the browser and copy PEM, JWK, and a JWKS. Convert between PEM and JWK. The private key is not sent, logged, or stored.

name: CSP builder
tagline: Build a Content-Security-Policy and a Next.js headers snippet.
description: Free Content-Security-Policy generator. Fill in directives or paste a policy, then copy the header and a next.config headers() snippet. Warnings call out wildcards, unsafe-inline, and a missing object-src or frame-ancestors.

name: Sitemap validator
tagline: Check a sitemap URL or XML, or generate a urlset from a list.
description: Free XML sitemap checker. Fetch a public sitemap, or paste XML, and see URL counts, lastmod problems, and a sample of HTTP statuses. Generate a urlset from a list of URLs. Private addresses are refused.

name: HTTP headers
tagline: Follow redirects and grade the security headers on a public URL.
description: Free HTTP header checker. Fetch a public URL, list the redirect chain, and grade HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, framing, nosniff, and Referrer-Policy. Private addresses are refused. The body is discarded.

name: SSL checker
tagline: Expiry, names, and the chain for a certificate on port 443.
description: Free SSL certificate checker. Connect to a public host on port 443 and report days until expiry, the subject, issuer, subject alternative names, protocol, and chain. Private addresses are refused.

name: TOTP authenticator
tagline: Live 2FA codes for your accounts, with otpauth:// import and QR export.
description: Free TOTP and HOTP authenticator. Add accounts with a base32 secret, watch live codes tick down with a countdown, copy with one click, and import or export otpauth:// provisioning URIs. Everything runs in the browser; secrets never leave the page.

name: JSONPath tester
tagline: Query JSON with JSONPath Plus and inspect every match.
description: Free JSONPath tester. Paste a JSON document, write a JSONPath Plus query, and see each match with its path and a count. Syntax mistakes are reported with the position, and filters, slices, unions, and recursive descent all work.

name: Programmer calculator
tagline: Base conversions, bitwise ops, and a clickable bit grid.
description: Free programmer calculator. Convert between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal with live sync, evaluate expressions with C-like precedence, run bitwise AND, OR, XOR, NOT and shifts, toggle individual bits, and read signed and unsigned 8/16/32/64-bit interpretations plus the ASCII character.

name: AES encryption
tagline: AES-GCM encrypt and decrypt in the browser, nothing uploaded.
description: Free AES encryption playground. Encrypt text with AES-256-GCM: the key is derived from your passphrase with PBKDF2-SHA256, and a fresh random salt and IV are generated every time. Decrypt a bundle back to plaintext. Everything runs locally with WebCrypto.

name: HAR analyzer
tagline: Drop a HAR capture, see where the time went.
description: Free HAR file analyzer. Drop a .har capture or paste its JSON to get a request table with method, URL, status, size, and time, plus summary stats: totals, status-code distribution, the slowest requests, the largest payloads, top hosts, and a per-request timing breakdown of blocked, DNS, connect, send, wait, and receive.
